bull.probability_evidence: Evaluation bull case: 12m trend intact (+36.9%, +21.2pp vs SPY), 50-day MA +5.3% above 200-day, Q2 beat-and-raise with ROIC 13.6%/FCF margin 9.9% TTM, and valuation (14.2x P/E, 11.4x EV/EBITDA) below both 5y minimums and peer medians -- but conviction is only 3/5 (AVOID) because the pullback itself fell outside the -5%/+2% band and undercut a prior swing low, so the bull weight is held at 25%, not higher (research/DLTR/2026-10-08-evaluation.md Bull case and Decision.rationale).

target_band.cite: Bull basis re-rates TTM P/E 14.2x to the 17.2x peer median (factsheet Valuation, RA/P:DG,WMT,TGT,FIVE): priced on P/E, implied price = (116.30/14.2 EPS)*17.2 = 140.87; on EV/EBITDA (current 11.4x, net debt/EBITDA 2.64x, mkt cap 22.1bn -> EBITDA 2.523bn; peer median 13.2x) implied price = 140.14; on P/FCF (116.30/11.1 FCF/share * peer median 17.2x) implied price = 180.21. Half the spread (180.21-140.14)/2 = 20.04, relative to the 140.87 target = 14.2%.

base.probability_evidence: Evaluation base case: the pullback setup is 'marginal' (conviction 3/5, AVOID) with no fresh directional catalyst either way, so the evaluator assigns the base case the majority weight by default while bull/bear carry the tail outcomes (research/DLTR/2026-10-08-evaluation.md Decision.rationale: 'Conviction 3, so AVOID; cash is acceptable').

target_band.cite: Base basis is a flat-multiple, price-only reversion to the 50-day MA (123.27, factsheet Price/HI), not a re-rating: current P/E 14.2x, EV/EBITDA 11.4x and P/FCF 11.1x (factsheet Valuation, RA) all reconstruct today's 116.30 close with no disagreement between anchors, so there is no valuation-anchor spread underlying this target -- band = 0.

bear.probability_evidence: Evaluation bear case: trend structure breaking (swing highs 137.07->134.99, 21-Sep swing low 111.23 undercutting the 27-Aug low 118.11), relative strength -9.1pp/-7.8pp vs SPY over 3m/6m, and the stock sold off on its own beat-and-raise with part of Q2 EPS from one-off tariff refunds -- enough to balance the bull tail at 25% given marginal conviction (research/DLTR/2026-10-08-evaluation.md Bear case).
